item.title: Article: Implementing Durable Workflows on Postgres Without an External Orchestrator
item.description: Postgres can serve as the durable state store and coordination layer for workflows, eliminating the need for an external orchestrator. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Homebrew: 7.0.0 - faster installations and upgrades, stronger sandboxing, a native macOS app, built-in vulnerability checks and an advisory database, the end of macOS 10.15 support and Intel Macs moving to Tier 3.
item.description: Users must upgrade to macOS 11 or later, as this is now the minimum supported version. macOS Sonoma 14: This version is now considered Tier 3, and users are encouraged to upgrade to Sequoia 15+ for full support. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: TIL: One lock to rule them all
item.description: I've been running multiple migrations recently. A common step in all of them is a long cleanup action at the end. I ended up using postgres advisory locks and sqlx. (1 source: rprogramming)
